sentences.text: Heard.
Perused the First Information Report (FIR) and related  papers.
Except the offence under Section 328 of Indian Penal Code, rest  of the offences are bailable one.
I am of the view that Section 328 of  the Indian Penal Code, may not be applicable to the present case.
The  crime came to be registered against the applicant simply because of  seizure of the Gutkha in the truck.
He was called by the truck driver.
The articles came to be seized from the truck.
The applicant is neither  the truck driver nor owner of the truck.
Prima-facie, there is nothing to  connect the applicant with the crime in question.

Hence, following  order:
 ORDER I.
The application is allowed.

II. In the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with Crime No.0162/2019 registered at Tadaklas Police Station, Taluka Purna, District Parbhani, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 328, 272, 273, read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code and under Section 26(2) (IV), 27(3) (D), 27(3) (E), 30(2) (a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the applicant be 2 of 3 3 aba-1512-19.doc released on executing P. R. bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand Only) with surety bond in the like amount.
III. The applicant shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required.
IV. The application is disposed of.
